affected_records.correction_reason: In the NCT03658681 primary Methods text, SCFA are stated to be measured in EDTA plasma at Vitas, while the subsequent QTRAP5500/Kinetex Biphenyl LC-MS/MS method is explicitly introduced for nine bile acids. The adjacent bile-acid method must not be rebound to SCFA.

The NCT01034436 2020 primary report explicitly binds fasting EDTA-plasma SCFA measurement to GC-MS at Vitas. NCT03658681 does not explicitly bind its SCFA measurement to LC-MS/MS; its reported LC-MS/MS QTRAP/Kinetex method belongs to bile acids.

claim_ceiling: This correction fixes analyte-to-method provenance binding; it does not establish the true SCFA method for NCT03658681.
Both NCT03293693 and NCT03658681 SCFA method families remain unresolved in the checked primary articles.
Two unresolved method labels do not establish method identity or comparability.
The NCT01034436 SCFA GC-MS binding remains supported by its primary report.
No real hardened comparable pair, new authoritative observation, pooled reference, clinical target or human dosing guidance is established.
